(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState>=2) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } __app.showTab('player'); __app.player.video.pause(); return 'flat video button enabled: ' + ![...document.querySelectorAll('#pillbar button')].find(b=>/Flat video/.test(b.textContent)).disabled; })()

(async()=>{ [...document.querySelectorAll('#pillbar button')].find(b=>/Flat video/.test(b.textContent)).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); [...m.querySelectorAll('.seg button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Follow my view').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); return [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.textContent).join(' | '); })()

(async()=>{ const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/Record from the beginning/.test(b.textContent)).click(); const view=__app.player.view; const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<3500){ const k=(performance.now()-t0)/3500; view.yaw = (0.7 - 1.4*k); view.pitch = 0.15*Math.sin(k*6.28); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } const badge=document.querySelector('.cam-rec-badge'); const txt=badge.innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' '); [...badge.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Stop').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const m2=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); return 'badge: ' + txt + ' · after stop: ' + (m2 && m2.querySelector('.reframe-rec')?.innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10))[0]); })()

(async()=>{ const done=new Promise(r=>{ vr180.onJobDone(j=>r(j)); vr180.onJobFailed(j=>r(j)); }); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); [...m.querySelectorAll('.seg button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='720p').click(); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Make the video').click(); const t=performance.now(); const j=await done; return { ms: Math.round(performance.now()-t), status: j.status, stage: j.stage, output: j.output, error: j.error }; })()
